title: Man. Post. Cap. VIII: conscience recoils — God punishing infants by bare imputation
pass_a_gloss: It deeply offends Placeus that you and certain other brothers say God punishes all humans, even little children, with bodily (and eternal) death—indeed with death of the soul, which formally is sin—for an actual sin that is theirs in no way except by imputation, because God imputes it to them. Conscience shudders even to think it, and Placeus earnestly begs the Lord to give you and them another mind.
pass_b_english: For it vehemently offends me that you, and certain other brothers of ours, say that God punishes all humans, even little children, with death of the body (and eternal), indeed with death of the soul, which formally is sin, for an actual sin which is theirs in no way, except by imputation, because God imputes it to them. Conscience shudders even to think it, and that he may give you and them another mind, I earnestly beg the Lord from the heart.
source_text: Me enim vehementer offendit, quod tu, & alii quidam fratres nostri, dicitis, Deum omnes homines, etiam puerulos, punire morte corporis (& aeterna) immo morte animae, quae formaliter peccatum est, ob peccatum actuale quod eorum non est ullo modo, nisi imputatione, quia Deus illud ipsis imputat. Id vel cogitare horret conscientia, ac ut aliam tibi & illis mentem det, Dominum supplex ex animo precor.

choices.choice: Recoils from punishing infants by bare imputation of actual sin
